name: DarkSPHERE
summary: DarkSPHERE is a large spherical-gas-detector proposal building on NEWS-G technology, planning underground electroforming of a low-radioactivity copper sphere at Boulby to improve sensitivity to low-mass dark matter.
detection_principle: A central multianode electric field collects and amplifies ionization in low-background gas, enabling studies of nuclear recoils, electron scattering and long superheavy-dark-matter tracks.

sites.name: Boulby Underground Laboratory
sites.site_status: Deployment site proposed in the conceptual design

status.label: Proposed
status.evidence: The 2023 concept paper explicitly describes a proposal; projected sensitivity is not experimental data.

results.summary: Conceptual design and projected sensitivity regions, not measured observational limits.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
